summary: Iter 92.63 RETEST — 8/10 pass. AUTOSYNC-ON-LOGIN and SECURITY-FIX both VERIFIED working. Push-to-Supabase FK bug is NOT fully fixed: the Iter 92.62 patch resolves the correct auth.users id (auto-creates if missing) but Supabase still rejects the leadership_insights write with FK code 23503 — 'Key (user_id)=(<uuid>) is not present in table users'. Root cause: `leadership_insights.user_id` FK references public.users but the admin API POST /auth/v1/admin/users only inserts into auth.users; the corresponding row in public.users is never created (no trigger installed / disabled). Endpoint returns 502 which Cloudflare replaces with its own Bad Gateway HTML — user never sees the real backend detail.

critical.issue: FK 23503 still fires. Backend log: `Supabase write: status=409 body={"code":"23503","details":"Key (user_id)=(e8322cda-9170-4ebe-bcc0-99536d633754) is not present in table \"users\""...}`. The auto-created auth.users id is not mirrored into public.users, so the leadership_insights FK breaks. Fix options: (a) run SQL to add trigger `on auth.user created → insert public.users`, (b) drop the FK constraint if not needed, (c) after admin/users create, explicitly `INSERT INTO public.users (id, email) VALUES (sb_uid, email)` via PostgREST before the leadership_insights write.

When Supabase write fails, endpoint raises HTTPException(502). Cloudflare intercepts 5xx and replaces the JSON detail with its own HTML error page (`<title>preview.emergentagent.com | 502: Bad gateway</title>`), so users/clients never see the real error. Use 409/422/500 with detail or 200+{status:'error'} to bypass CDN interception.

minor.issue: The Supabase error body is logged as `INFO` at wladbot logger — should be `ERROR` for FK-fail cases so operators notice.

Change push-to-supabase failure status from 502 to 409 or 422 so Cloudflare does not swallow the JSON detail. Include supabase_error_body in the detail for easier debugging.
Consider seeding public.users when Supabase mirroring happens on register (services_wladhub_autosync.mirror_user_event_fire_and_forget) — currently only auth.users may be touched.

rca_of_the_issue: The Iter 92.62 push-to-supabase fix addressed the WRONG UUID (SHA256-derived → real auth.users id) but did NOT address the WRONG TABLE. Supabase project has a FK `leadership_insights.user_id → public.users.id` (NOT `auth.users.id`). `POST /auth/v1/admin/users` only inserts into `auth.users`. Without a `handle_new_user` trigger that mirrors auth.users → public.users (a very common Supabase pattern that is apparently missing/disabled here), the FK will keep failing. Two possible fixes: (1) enable the standard `on auth.users insert → insert public.users(id, email)` trigger inside Supabase Studio, or (2) inside push-to-supabase, after creating the auth user, also POST to `/rest/v1/users` with the same id — using `Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates` so it's idempotent.
